fields.summary_ko.0: Seagate (STX), Lam Research, Marvell (MRVL), onsemi, Western Digital (WDC) and other semiconductor and hardware stocks rallied together as concerns over AI data center regulation eased, with S&P 500 technology sector up 2% on Monday.
fields.summary_ko.1: Seagate up 77.6% since early year but currently at $510.73, down 53.3% from 52-week high of $1,094 (June 2026), with JPMorgan expecting tech stock recovery based on view that AI is not a continuing selloff.
